title: Kiss Knot Bangle
descriptionHtml:
Two ends, one kiss. A flexible snake-coil bangle, finely ribbed and about 5mm thick, whose two ends cross on top of the wrist under one smooth polished X. In warm gold or bright silver tone.

STYLING TIP: Wear gold and silver together with both knots on top of the wrist.

Details

  • Construction: Flexible ribbed snake coil, approximately 5mm thick
  • Front: The two ends cross under one smooth polished X, approximately 12mm
  • Fit: Flexible, slips over the hand
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated or rhodium plated silver tone (choose above)
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
